title: [Bug]: Docker - JWT authentication not enforced when enabled - requests without tokens are incorrectly allowed
author: ntohidi

comments.author: ntohidi
comments.body:
### Root caused

The Bug

  In deploy/docker/auth.py:

  1. Line 13: security = HTTPBearer(auto_error=False)
    - This means no automatic error when Authorization header is missing
  2. Lines 34-35 in verify_token:
  if credentials is None:
      return None  # ← BUG: Should raise 401 error!

When JWT is enabled but no token is provided, the code returns None instead of raising an authentication error. This allows requests through without authentication!

comments.author: mati-kw
comments.body: This should be released immediately since is an auth issue still persistent in "recommended" docker deploys and "security measures"
